name: humanizer
description: Use when you want to humanize an existing draft, make writing sound less robotic, or review AI-writing patterns without rewriting. Preserves meaning and voice across articles, emails, newsletters, and social posts.

interface.longDescription: Make an existing draft sound more natural by removing generic phrasing, repetitive patterns, and other AI-writing tells. Use with articles, emails, newsletters, or social posts while preserving meaning, voice, quotations, and links. You can also ask for a pattern-only review without rewriting. Does not fact-check, detect plagiarism, or establish who wrote the text.
